pages.text: $(italic)Create$() carries a full redstone toolkit of its own — documented in depth in the $(bold)Create Compendium$(). The headline parts:$(br)$(li)$(bold)Redstone Link$() + $(bold)Redstone Contact$() — wireless signal between two points.$(li)$(bold)Linked Controller$() — handheld control of link frequencies.
pages.title: Create · Wireless

pages.text: $(li)$(bold)Powered Latch$() / $(bold)Toggle Latch$() — memory cells.$(li)$(bold)Pulse Repeater$(), $(bold)Pulse Extender$(), $(bold)Pulse Timer$() — pulse shaping.$(li)$(bold)Smart Observer$(), $(bold)Redstone Requester$() — content-aware sensing.$(li)$(bold)Desk Bell$() & $(bold)Placard$() — emit a signal when used.$(br2)All explained, with Ponder scenes, in the Compendium.
pages.title: Create · Logic

pages.text: $(bold)Create add-ons$() extend it further:$(br)$(li)$(italic)Create Crafts & Additions$() — $(bold)Redstone Relay$(): gates Forge Energy on a redstone signal.$(li)$(italic)Create Connected$() — $(bold)Sequenced Pulse Generator$(), $(bold)Redstone Link Wildcard$().$(li)$(italic)Vibrant Vaults$() — coloured $(bold)Redstone Requesters$().$(li)$(italic)Create Hypertube$() — a $(bold)Redstone Detector$() attachment.
